content.stem: 一家银行的交易监控系统对一家经营洗车业务的客户发出了警报。该客户存入大量现金后，又发起了国际电汇。以下哪种额外情况会使该案更可疑？

options.A: 电汇的受益人是一家外国公司，其股东和董事均为其他公司
options.B: 这些电汇的金额各不相同，但收款人相同
options.C: 电汇的受益人是来自灰名单国家的居民
options.D: 电汇受益人居住在外国，且与企业主同姓

content.stem_en: The transaction monitoring system of a bank generated an alert for a car wash client. After making large cash deposits, the client orders international wire transfers. Which additional circumstances would make the case more suspicious?

options_en.A: The beneficiary of the wire transfers is a foreign company whose shareholders and directors are other companies
options_en.B: The wire transfers are for different amounts but with the same beneficiary
options_en.C: The beneficiary of the wire transfer is a resident of a grey-list country
options_en.D: The beneficiary of the wire transfers is a resident of a foreign country bearing the same family name as the business owner
